resources.string: Agent Bridge reads the screen as an element tree and performs taps you approve. It is an automation tool. It is off until you turn the service on and tap Arm. Stop is always on the notification and the Quick Settings tile.
Shown while a session is armed. Stop ends the session.
The agent can ask to use the screen. Stop ends it immediately.
Agent Bridge armed until you disarm
Timeouts are off. Stop, the tile, or the kill switch ends it immediately.
Messages between you and your agents. Android Auto reads these aloud.
Silent prompts so you can start a message while Android Auto is connected. No sound.
Your agents can message you in the car. Phone control still needs Arm.
